name: Level 0 General Fiction (Pack of 6) PINK
description: Jolly Phonics Pink Readers Complete Set is the fi rst of six levels of decodable books, providing the best start for children just starting to read. At every stage, the words are within the reach of children as they use their knowledge of the letter sounds and tricky words already taught. Tricky words are shown at the beginning of each book. Comprehension questions and discussion topics are provided at the end of each book, with guidance for teachers and parents. Light type is used as a guide for those few letters that should not be sounded out, such as the /b/ in lamb. Pink readers feature words that are spelled regularly, and can be sounded out with the 42 letter sounds fi rst taught in Jolly Phonics.
